subscribe.title: Subscribe to a calendar
subscribe.intro: Each calendar is an ICS feed that refreshes itself every few hours. Subscribe once and new talks appear on their own. A talk in several fields is in each of their calendars, and a conference or workshop is in the calendar of conferences and workshops as well, so it appears once per calendar you subscribe to.
subscribe.deadlines_note: Kept by hand from the organizers' pages; check a page before you rely on its date. The submission deadlines of the main tracks of machine-learning and computer-science conferences are not collected; {ccfddl} publishes those of the AI conferences as a calendar.
subscribe.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.

steps.step_1: On a Mac, open Calendar and choose New Calendar Subscription from the File menu.
steps.step_2: Paste the calendar app link of one of the calendars below and click Subscribe.
steps.step_3: Under Location choose iCloud, so that your iPhone and iPad get the calendar too.
steps.step_4: Set Auto-refresh, for example to Every day, and click OK.
steps.step_5: On an iPhone or iPad you can also tap a calendar app link and confirm with Subscribe.

disabled_reasons.bayarea-slac-ais: Dormant: the page still announces a "next seminar" of 2019-09-10.
disabled_reasons.bayarea-suncat: No public seminar: the Seminars list is empty, and the coming entries are internal group meetings.
disabled_reasons.custom-biox-seminars: The site answers every automated request with HTTP 403 (a Cloudflare browser challenge).
disabled_reasons.custom-it-forum: Nearly dormant (one talk in 2026, none announced), and its list gives no year, which no adapter can read yet.
disabled_reasons.custom-sail-events: Dormant: the public Google Calendar of the lab has no talk after 2023-04-11, only a weekly social tea; its events page lists no dates.
disabled_reasons.custom-theory-seminar: The seminar does not meet regularly. Of the four calendars on its page, its own has no talk after 2012 and another one is dormant; the other two are the RAIN/OR seminar and the Theory Lunch, collected from their own pages.
disabled_reasons.rsorg-stanford-ag: Dormant on researchseminars.org: the last talk was on 2025-03-14.
disabled_reasons.sites-bioengineering: A duplicate: every event here is an import from the Stanford Events calendar, which is collected anyway.
disabled_reasons.sites-cs: A duplicate: its events are imports from the Stanford Events calendar, which is collected anyway, and advising sessions; none is a talk of its own.
